transportRules.rule: Unloaded at all times while transported
Not visible from outside the vehicle (in a case or bag)
Kept secure: a locked container or a locked part of the vehicle where practicable
Ammunition stored separately from the firearm where practicable
The bolt or firing mechanism removed and kept apart where practicable
Never left unattended in a vehicle unless reasonable precautions are taken (locked and out of sight)
Licence carried whenever you're in possession of the firearm
Only travel for a lawful purpose under your genuine reason (range, permitted property, gunsmith, storage)

beforeILeave.item: Firearm in locked case or bag
Case not visible from outside vehicle

interstateNotes: NSW: NSW Firearms Act 1996 applies. QLD licence is recognised but you must comply with NSW transport and storage rules. Category A/B firearms may be used for hunting on private land with landowner permission. Hunting in NSW state forests requires an R-Licence from NSW DPI (Game and Feral Animal Control).
